ck_assignment_status_fields.name: ck_assignment_status_fields
ck_assignment_status_fields.value: ((status = 'ACTIVE'::assignment_status) AND (returned_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'RETURNED'::assignment_status) AND (returned_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'CANCELLED'::assignment_status) AND (returned_at IS NULL))

ck_incident_status_fields.name: ck_incident_status_fields
ck_incident_status_fields.value: ((status = 'RESOLVED'::incident_status) AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'RESOLVED'::incident_status) AND (resolved_at IS NULL))

ck_asset_next_maintenance_date.name: ck_asset_next_maintenance_date
ck_asset_next_maintenance_date.value: (last_maintenance_date IS NULL) OR (next_maintenance_date IS NULL) OR (next_maintenance_date >= last_maintenance_date)

ck_lot_expiry_after_manufacture.name: ck_lot_expiry_after_manufacture
ck_lot_expiry_after_manufacture.value: (manufactured_date IS NULL) OR (expiry_date IS NULL) OR (expiry_date >= manufactured_date)

ck_item_type_tracking_mode.name: ck_item_type_tracking_mode
ck_item_type_tracking_mode.value: ((item_type = 'MATERIAL'::item_type) AND (tracking_mode IN ('QUANTITY'::tracking_mode, 'LOT'::tracking_mode))) OR ((item_type IN ('EQUIPMENT'::item_type, 'TOOL'::item_type)) AND (tracking_mode IN ('QUANTITY'::tracking_mode, 'ASSET'::tracking_mode)))

ck_maintenance_time_order.name: ck_maintenance_time_order
ck_maintenance_time_order.value: ((started_at IS NULL) OR (scheduled_at IS NULL) OR (started_at >= scheduled_at)) AND ((completed_at IS NULL) OR (started_at IS NULL) OR (completed_at >= started_at))

ck_maintenance_status_fields.name: ck_maintenance_status_fields
ck_maintenance_status_fields.value: ((status = 'SCHEDULED'::maintenance_status) AND (started_at IS NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'IN_PROGRESS'::maintenance_status) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'COMPLETED'::maintenance_status) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'CANCELLED'::maintenance_status) AND (completed_at IS NULL))

ck_count_confirm_fields.name: ck_count_confirm_fields
ck_count_confirm_fields.value: (status <> 'CONFIRMED'::stock_count_status) OR ((confirmed_by_member_id IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))

ck_issue_maintenance_reference.name: ck_issue_maintenance_reference
ck_issue_maintenance_reference.value: ((issue_type = 'MAINTENANCE'::issue_type) AND (maintenance_record_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((issue_type <> 'MAINTENANCE'::issue_type) AND (maintenance_record_id IS NULL))

ck_issue_confirm_fields.name: ck_issue_confirm_fields
ck_issue_confirm_fields.value: (status <> 'CONFIRMED'::document_status) OR ((confirmed_by_member_id IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))

ck_receipt_item_lot_dates.name: ck_receipt_item_lot_dates
ck_receipt_item_lot_dates.value: (manufactured_date IS NULL) OR (expiry_date IS NULL) OR (expiry_date >= manufactured_date)

ck_receipt_confirm_fields.name: ck_receipt_confirm_fields
ck_receipt_confirm_fields.value: (status <> 'CONFIRMED'::document_status) OR ((confirmed_by_member_id IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))

ck_transfer_confirm_fields.name: ck_transfer_confirm_fields
ck_transfer_confirm_fields.value: (status <> 'CONFIRMED'::document_status) OR ((confirmed_by_member_id IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))
